scope: One independent native NEST realization and two-second observation; no statistical equivalence claim.

sampling.lvr: Uniform without replacement from all cells; zero-padded and >=3-spike means both reported.
sampling.correlation: Uniform without replacement from active cells; zero-variance cells excluded.
sampling.raster: Independent uniform 3% of each population in V1, V2, FEF, rounded up.
sampling.caveat: These frozen sampling and endpoint conventions are not claimed identical to the historical paper seed or every official helper.
